home_faq1_q: How much does a website cost?
home_faq1_a: It depends on what it has to do. A site presenting three services and one with online bookings are two different projects. Tell us the goal and we send you a fixed written quote listing everything it includes — no costs appearing along the way.
home_faq2_a: A simple presentation page: 1–2 weeks. A complete business site: 3–5 weeks. Apps and platforms depend on their scope, but you get a clear timeline before we start.
home_faq3_q: What do I need to prepare?
home_faq3_a: Ideally: copy, photos and a logo. If you do not have them, we help — we write the content together and tell you exactly which photos are needed.
home_faq4_q: How do the domain and hosting work?
home_faq4_a: They stay in your name, at HostGate. We guide you through the purchase, configure DNS and SSL and publish the site. We never hold your site hostage.
home_faq5_a: You are left with a site that works and, if you want, with us behind it: updates, backups, uptime monitoring and content changes on request.
home_faq6_q: Do you work outside Alba Iulia?
home_faq6_a: Yes. We do most projects 100% remotely, with short calls and written updates at every stage.
